note: Wooded bottomland area along 1.4 miles of the Black River west of Williamsville, reached by County Road 424 and gravel area roads. MDC's map marks the primitive camping area at the east river lot, beside an unimproved boat launch onto a sand bank; a second camping spot sits on a dirt lane by the river at the west end. No facilities; spot length is not published. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: MDC 'Individual Campsites' (brochure: 'Primitive camping is permitted in designated camping areas'), free, FCFS, no hookups, 14-day limit. Two GIS camping points 660 m apart (no split). The stored pin is the WEST point, on a dirt lane under canopy that MDC's 03/15 map does not mark as camping; the mapped camping area is at the EAST lot on the gravel road - pin move to the east lot suggested. Not waterfront kept; riverview lead at the east lot (ramp apron). Phone matches.
flags: PIN (suggest move): stored 36.96368,-90.56239 = GIS camping point 1061, beside GIS lot 2743 (attribute 'Paved', its Lat attribute reads 39.043482 - a typo). On leaf-off imagery there is no lot there: just a dirt lane under full tree cover ~20 m from the river, reached by an unsurfaced woods track, and the 03/15 map shows a parking-lot symbol there but NO camping symbol. MDC's map puts its only Primitive Camping Area symbol at the EAST river lot (GIS lot 1806, 36.96317,-90.55449 - a sandy open clearing at the end of the visibly graveled main area road, beside the unimproved boat launch), with GIS camping point 351 (36.96349,-90.55492) in the woods ~50 m NW of it. Suggest moving the pin to ~36.96330,-90.55470 (east lot / camping point 351).

CLUSTER: 2 GIS camping points 664 m apart, both reached from the same area road off County Road 424 - no split. Third lot (8230, gravel, 36.9586,-90.56112) is an inland parking lot with no camping point.
FIT: east lot is a ~35 x 30 m open clearing at the end of ~1.3 km of gravel area road - a 23-ft rig fits. West spot: dirt lane through woods, surface/width not verifiable under canopy.

WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront, kept): Black River ~50-60 m wide here (riverfront class). East: GIS camping point 351 is ~55-60 m from the water through woods; the open lot itself is ~15 m from the water across an open sand bank, but that lot is the unimproved boat-launch apron - LEAD riverview at most (same shape as Blair Bridge 13792), riverfront not earned. West: camping point 1061 ~20-25 m from the river, all under bank-tree canopy - no open sightline confirmable; LEAD only, stays down.
PHONE: 573-663-7130 on the area page matches.
